tools.name: search_cv_cm
tools.description: Search every page on cv.cm: free browser tools, personality tests, rankings, datasets, tutorials, memes, pose reference, country, food, emoji and breed pages. Returns titles, one-line descriptions and page URLs. Send the user to the url to use a tool or take a test; cite the url when you quote a pag

tools.name: list_cv_cm_pages
tools.description: List the pages of one cv.cm section (for example every personality test or every ranking), with titles, descriptions and URLs, page by page.

tools.name: get_cv_cm_ranking
tools.description: Rows of a sourced ranking on cv.cm (AI models, browser and phone market share, commodities, currencies, mountains, rivers, lakes, islands, deserts, buildings, cities, stadiums), with its source, licence, update date and page URL. ids: ai-models, ai-coding-models, ai-image-models, ai-video-models, ai

tools.name: get_cv_cm_dataset
tools.description: Rows of a public reference table on cv.cm (World Bank indicators by country such as GDP, population and life expectancy; country, calling and currency codes; time zones; paper sizes; ASCII), with its source, licence, update date, CSV and page URL. ids: gdp, gdp-ppp, gdp-per-capita, gdp-ppp-per-capit

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_cv_cm, list_cv_cm_pages, get_cv_cm_ranking, get_cv_cm_dataset · Public sink: search_cv_cm, get_cv_cm_ranking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_cv_cm, list_cv_cm_pages, get_cv_cm_ranking, get_cv_cm_dataset · Public sink: search_cv_cm, get_cv_cm_ranking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
